sentence: This project tests why learners do better when they watch an instructor draw diagrams by hand during lessons.
This project combines courses from computer science, criminology and management information systems to build broader cybersecurity knowledge.
This project continues a center that does research on advanced manufacturing and moves into research areas such as cybersecurity.
This project updates a system that sequences individual microbial cells from environmental samples and links their genetic information to physical traits.
This project studies how natural selection and gene flow shape the splitting of species, using speckled rattlesnakes.
This project uses a microscope to watch cell processes in living animals, including chicken embryos.
This project studies how defects cause soft elastomer structures to fail when electricity makes them change shape.
This project builds mathematical methods for artificial intelligence, including ways to generate data and to detect anomalies.
This project builds computer tools that classify bird calls, collect ocean data and measure fish for scientists and explorers.
This project builds tools that measure the shapes of proteins and RNA by unfolding them and tracking their size and shape.
This project builds a platform from carbon nanotubes and phase change materials whose response to circularly polarized light can be switched electrically.
This project uses mathematics to improve quantum algorithms and quantum cryptography.
This project searches for dark matter using silicon detectors that can sense the charge from a single electron.
This project develops ways to model and control robots that change their shape to do different tasks.
This project obtains a laser-based 3D nanoprinting instrument that builds three-dimensional structures at very small scales.
This project studies how bacteria called Wolbachia make insect sperm sterile and how the genes involved move and evolve.
